## Corrected deployment transaction started

Two isolated fixes have landed in the required order:

- PR #119, squash `41f78f4357c1da7fcfbeb4838a04b9e3414fbf3a`: readiness now observes all `scripts/**`, so deploy-only validation/smoke fixes cannot silently fail to retrigger the pipeline.
- PR #123, squash `a6a783044af69b8cc019f6885368ad67aa6a19f2`: the Gill layout audit now enforces the canonical frosted-bar contract (blur active, alpha >= .75) while retaining all 24-route/viewport/theme layout, contrast, overlap, overflow and TOC assertions. Transaction run `29882284960` and final Shared Files Guard `29882717875` passed.

The merge of #123 is script-only and is now covered by #119, so it should start the final readiness → Pages chain automatically. Keeping #58 open until the observer posts successful Pages for `a6a78304` (or a later exact head containing it) plus PASS for all five production blobs.
